sec.title: August 30 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 431)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **August 30** across American network radio, British BBC light comedy, and wartime dramatic archives, Marsha Hunt and Claire Trevor starring on *Stars Over Hollywood* for Dari-Rich Chocolate Milk (1941, 1947), Sheriff Mark Chase tackling desert cliff bandits on *Death Valley Sheriff* for 20 Mule Team Borax (1946), Jimmy Clitheroe's domestic mishaps on *The Clitheroe Kid* (1970), moral crisis on *This Is Our Enemy* (1942), and Paul McGrath in the psychological noir *Detour* (1941–1970):
